topic: How does the MFbB architecture impact beamforming scan loss trade-offs versus user terminal G/T requirements in GEO satellites?
consensus_response: The MFbB architecture presents a trade-off between contiguous coverage and complexity in GEO satellites. While it offers improved contiguous coverage with fewer reflectors, it also introduces scan loss and increased complexity in the beamforming network. Advanced beamforming techniques can help mitigate scan loss, but they also introduce additional computational and hardware demands. The MFbB architecture may offer a cost-effective solution for high-throughput applications, provided that the trade-offs are carefully evaluated and managed.
reference_context: The MFbB architecture uses a cluster of feeds to produce each beam, offering contiguous coverage with fewer reflectors.
